statement.source_mapping: Research/Submission.lean formalizes the full active lemma:traingular_update in /spec/source.txt and /spec/paper.tex lines 403-452. Source coordinates 1,...,k correspond to Fin k values 0,...,k-1. The inner product uses exactly the first k-1 entries; its first rounded product initializes the accumulator and subsequent additions are rounded. IsEvaluation existentially quantifies bounded local relative errors for these operations, subtraction, and division; this is the standard floating-point model under no overflow/underflow, with no assumed algorithmic bound. Unit roundoff is nonnegative and k*u<1. computedValue is the actual evaluation, and perturbation gives an explicit witness with dot-product factors and inverse final-operation factors. triangular_update_constructed states the exact backward equation and every gamma_k component bound for this witness; triangular_update states the source existential result for every such evaluation. Supporting source.txt, paper.tex, references.bib, and source.pdf were copied unchanged to Research; /spec/support contained no files. No feedback.json was present; no feedback-driven statement revision was made. The plan is used only as a fallible handoff. Only the proof of triangular_update_constructed is temporarily sorry; all construction definitions have actual bodies, and triangular_update is derived from it.

verification.limitation: Compilation alone does not establish the original theorem or algorithm. Semantic review is required.

requirements.evidence: Both triangular_update_constructed and triangular_update already conclude the exact backward equation and all componentwise gamma(k) bounds for arbitrary admissible inputs. The latter covers every yhat satisfying IsEvaluation; no missing composition of supporting lemmas is needed.

requirements.requirement: Define the sequential inner product followed by the rounded subtraction and division in the scalar update.
requirements.evidence: roundedProduct is P_i=a_i b_i(1+xi_i). sequentialDot starts S_1=P_0 and continues S_(m+1)=(S_m+P_m)(1+delta_m). computedValue uses S_(k-1), rounded subtraction with factor 1+eta, then division by b_(k-1) with factor 1+zeta. LocalErrors bounds exactly the errors used by these operations. These explicit recurrences encode the source standard relative-error model; a concrete floating-point format is not required by that model.

requirements.requirement: Prove the stated perturbed equation, including the pivot, and all componentwise gamma(k) bounds.
requirements.evidence: Both targets assert sum_(i=0)^(k-2) a_i(b_i+Delta b_i)+yhat(b_(k-1)+Delta b_(k-1))=c and |Delta b_i| <= [ku/(1-ku)]|b_i| for every i in Fin k. The explicit perturbation uses the accumulated product/addition weight on each nonpivot component and the reciprocal of (1+eta)(1+zeta) on the pivot. Thus the equality, pivot, component range, and constant all match the source.

requirements.evidence: The constructed target sets yhat to computedValue for the same a,b,c and error tuple used in perturbation. IsEvaluation requires this very yhat to equal computedValue for those original inputs and bounded error witnesses. BackwardEquation retains a and c, perturbs b, and multiplies its final entry by yhat. There is no unrelated output or replacement input.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the stated hypotheses and generality. Do not assume the conclusion or introduce a circular definition.
requirements.evidence: The targets retain k >= 2, ku < 1, arbitrary real a,b,c, and nonzero pivot. Nonnegative u is inherent in unit roundoff. The source no-overflow/no-underflow condition licenses precisely the local relative-error model used by the translation. IsEvaluation assumes only operation recurrences and local error bounds, not any backward equation or accumulated bound. Unused error coordinates cannot affect the result. Total division outside the target hypotheses is harmless: the pivot and both final error factors are nonzero within them.
